notes.title: Achievement Hotfix
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
-Fixed a bug causing the achievement "Collector" not to unlock for some Steam Users
-Fixed a bug causing the achievement "I Hate Insects" not to unlock for some Steam Users
-Fixed a bug causing the achievement "Survivalist" not to unlock for some Steam Users

Special thanks to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/MkayIndianaJones]@MkayShock Madness[/url] for identifying and reporting the issues!

notes.title: Difficulty Balancing Update
notes.content:
[b]You spoke and we listened![/b]

We noticed quite a few reviews and some community discussions around the game difficulty. 

In response, the entire Mushroom Grove region has been updated to be much more beginner-friendly and forgiving to the new players starting out. 

In addition, all the bosses have also been drastically improved (which should [i]hopefully[/i] reduce your rage-quits) and make the experience more fair/fun!

We hope you enjoy the update and look forward to hearing more from you all in the future!

:)

notes.title: Leaderboards, Boosts & More | Massive Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

After another year of hard work on Ladybug Quest since our initial release in 2019, we are super excited to share this massive update with you!

We have added some extremely exciting new core-features, drastically improved performance, fixed hundreds of bugs, and much more.

Here is a breakdown of the epic new features and improvements:

[list]
[*]Added 7 completely new, game-altering boosts
[*]Added a new shop to make good use of your in-game coins
[*]Added time-based leaderboards so players can compete to be the fastest speed-runners
[*]Added 11 new boost-related Steam achievements
[*]Polished and upgraded many levels
[*]Fixed over 300 minor (and a few major) bugs
[*]Drastically improved performance (by over 200%)
[*]Completely overhauled the majority of the UI and made it easier to navigate
[*]Re-wrote the entire input system (fixing major issues related to low FPS movement)
[*]Added enemy paths to make the game more skill-based and less rage-quity
[*]Plus many, many other minor changes and quality of life improvements
[/list]

We hope you enjoy this update and look forward to seeing your scores on the leaderboards!
Happy gaming!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/546160/Ladybug_Quest/

We also produced a new trailer for the update:
[previewyoutube=r6CCOKkAIyU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Massive Update | Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We know we've gone quiet for the last while, however, we are extremely excited to announce a massive update that's coming soon!

We've been working extremely hard on improving the core gameplay experience, adding more interesting content, and a huge surprise!

There will also be an incredible amount of bug fixes and quality of life tweaks/upgrades.

Stay tuned, get ready, and as always, happy gaming!

notes.title: Multi-Language Support | Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34171941/96bd986232ebdad7bbc29dc3eac0409afadc7353.jpg[/img]

Hello all!

We have added multi-language support to Ladybug Quest - supported languages now include: 
English, 
French, 
Italian, 
German, 
Spanish, 
Russian, 
and Simplified Chinese

We hope this helps bring the game a little closer to your native language!
:NinjaHappy:

notes.title: Patch | Difficulty Change & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The latest build for Ladybug Quest has quite a few minor bug fixes, as well as a major in-game change. 

The player will now spawn with 10 lives per level instead of 5. This was done to help keep the fun and well-balanced.

We will continue to listen to feedback and tweak/change things as needed.

Thanks and happy gaming!
:NinjaHappy:
